Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صِيَامِيْ فِيْهِ بِالشُّكْرِ وَالْقُبُولِ عَلَى مَا تَرْضَاهُ وَيَرْضَاهُ الرَّسُولُ
Translation: O Allah, make my fasting in this day with thankfulness and acceptance according to what pleases You and pleases the Messenger
With its branches firmly established upon its roots

Arabic text: بِحَقِّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: By the right of our master Muhammad and his pure family
And all praise is for Allah, the Lord of the worlds
